_about: SYNTHETIC Sprint 1 seed data for #30. Not real client menus, prices or recipes (PRD §2.1, #13). IDs are generated by the seed script; rows refer to each other by code. logo_url values point to a domain that never resolves, so the app shows its missing-photo fallback. quantity_on_hand stays 0 because it must equal the sum of stock movements, and Sprint 1 posts none.
_schema: Matches server/prisma/schema.prisma on origin/development (2026-10-16), plus brands.code from #84.
